_comment: LEO ISS proton chain template. Fill environment.proton_file with a real
orbit-averaged trapped-proton spectrum for 420km/51.6deg — e.g. SPENVIS
AP8 (TRP) differential flux export, or POST the file text to
path. Columns are energy[MeV] vs omni differential flux
[protons/cm2/s/MeV] (convert m^-2->cm^-2 by 1e-4 and sr->4pi if needed).
Per-domain proton sigma: CRAM/BRAM carry Wirthlin/JINST-2014 TSL 180 MeV
anchors -> rates are LOWER BOUNDS (reported as lower_bound). FF/DSP have
no measured proton sigma(E) -> excluded, marked gap.
Heavy-ion GCR at ISS is small vs trapped protons; add let_spectra_files
from a SPENVIS run for this orbit if you want both sources.

proton_sigma.source: Wirthlin/Takai/Harding JINST 2014 Table 1, TSL 180 MeV proton, XC7K325T CRAM
Wirthlin/Takai/Harding JINST 2014 Table 1, TSL 180 MeV proton, XC7K325T BRAM
